title: Chat request
summary: One request before the person answers: who asks, the trust facts (name not verified, account age, not in contacts) and three choices: accept, decline, or decline and block. Reporting is one more row.

inviterId.description: Matrix ID of the person who asks.

inviterHandle.description: The person's @, from the handle resolver.

isVerified.description: The person has the verified seal (server-held badge state).

accountAge.description: Account age formatted by the system (1 dia, 2 meses), for bipe_banner_unverified_body.

phase.description: invalid: the invite is gone or the room no longer exists (bipe_dm_invite_invalid). failed: accept or decline did not go through.

load.effect: Room.previewRoom (or RoomPreview from the room ID) for the inviter and the room info; resolves the @ and the badge.

accept.effect: Room.join, then opens chat-timeline. The room moves to Conversas.

decline.effect: Room.leave. The request goes away; the other person is not told.

declineAndBlock.effect: After the confirm (bipe_dm_decline_block_alert): Room.leave, then Client.ignoreUser for the inviter.

report.effect: Room.reportRoom with an optional reason, then decline. Shows bipe_dm_reported.

notes: No message text before accept: the preview shows the inviter and the trust facts only. Read receipts and typing are not sent before accept (the person is not a member yet).

Trust card (trust-ui.md, neutral level): bipe_banner_unverified_title with bipe_banner_unverified_body (%1$s account age), and bipe_request_unverified_body under it. A verified person shows the seal and the verified name instead.
Decline is silent for the other person: Matrix shows a leave, and Bipe shows no notice for it.

Bipe logic: BipeUnverifiedRequestCard and BipeTrustProfileCard (Android, libraries/bipe/ui); BipeTrustProfile, BadgeVerifier, BipeHandleResolver (iOS BipeKit). Account age and the other facts follow the trust facts rules (ADR 0074, registries/trust-facts.json, generated BipeTrustFacts).
